## Content check

- [ ] No organisation, tenant, customer, or vendor names
- [ ] No internal figures, IDs, or identifiers of any kind
- [ ] Still usable and specific enough to be worth shipping, not a hollow shell
- [ ] Correct licence for the content type (CC BY 4.0 for docs; MIT/Apache-2.0 for any bundled code, in its own subfolder)

## Checks

- [ ] PR does one thing
- [ ] Front matter present and consistent (artefact type, owner role, version, review cadence)
- [ ] Links to other artefacts in the kit (or the companion ITSM kit) are correct
- [ ] Australian English throughout
